text: It's nearly 2am and I'm shattered, sorry if this rambles. Looking after my nephew, he's 5 months. He's had a temperature on and off today. Every time the calpol kicks in he's back to himself, kicking about on his mat, babbling away at me, taking his bottles fine. His throat seems sore, he winces a bit when he swallows, but he's still drinking. Breathing's normal, I've watched him loads. Just want to know if I'm doing the right thing or if I'm missing something
